WoW: Forever

Feral — Cat Druid

Energy and combo points in Cat Form, on bleeds rather than big hits. Cat Form arrives at 20 from a quest chain. Before 20 you are a bear.

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

A guide to the live game, 1 to 60. Numbers are the client's at build 1.60.1.70938 with Blizzard's hotfixes through November 12. Talent orders are Icy Veins' and Wowhead's published builds, named and dated where they appear. Rotation advice past 40 comes from those two sites and from WoWSims, which is a model, and from combat logs WoWSims has fitted at levels 22 to 55. No raid is open until December 9, so nothing here rests on a raid log. Bear and Cat share one talent tree and one levelling build. They have separate pages because the rotations, stat priorities and gear are different. If a tooltip differs from the text, go by the text.

  • What Cat is for
  • Your talent points

What Cat is for

Damage out of stealth, at speed, and on bleeds that keep ticking while you reposition. Feral SwiftnessFeral SwiftnessTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 30%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 4%. 2/2 gives +30% movement speed in Cat Form and +4% dodge in all forms, and it works indoors. You also have ProwlProwlLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 40%. Lasts until cancelled., shapeshifting breaks roots, and RipRipLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost30 EnergyRangeMeleeDuration12 secFinishing move that causes damage over time. Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power: 1 point : 57 damage over 12 sec. 2 points: 90 damage over 12 sec. 3 points: 123 damage over 12 sec. 4 points: 156 damage over 12 sec. 5 points: 189 damage over 12 sec. scales with attack power and runs 12 seconds off five combo points.

It applies only from 20, when Cat Form arrives. Wowhead: "Leveling as a Feral Druid can start off feeling very slow, as Cat Form isn't available until Level 20." Icy Veins lists the same weakness, and one more: "No AoE damage in Cat Form."

Cat Form comes from a quest chain, not a trainer. "In WoW Forever, druids earn Cat Form with a quest chain at level 20. Your trainer sends you to Moonglade, the Great Cat Spirit asks for three relics hidden in the Stormrage Barrow Dens, and when you bring them back your trainer teaches you Cat Form, ProwlProwlLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 40%. Lasts until cancelled., ClawClawLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost45 EnergyRangeMeleeClaw the enemy for 140% normal damage plus 27. Awards 1 combo point. and RipRipLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost30 EnergyRangeMeleeDuration12 secFinishing move that causes damage over time. Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power: 1 point : 57 damage over 12 sec. 2 points: 90 damage over 12 sec. 3 points: 123 damage over 12 sec. 4 points: 156 damage over 12 sec. 5 points: 189 damage over 12 sec. in one go." It is 2,885 experience in total, and a relic looted in a group counts for the whole group.

Your talent points

Level 60: 9/32/10, Icy Veins' levelling order (page dated November 4, built on the November 3 trees). It is one build for both forms. Spend the points in this order:

  1. FerocityFerocityTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantReduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 5 Rage or Energy. 5, levels 10 to 14
  2. Feral InstinctFeral InstinctTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases damage done by your Swipe ability by 30% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling as if you were 3 levels higher. 3, levels 15 to 17
  3. Feral SwiftnessFeral SwiftnessTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 30%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 4%. 2, levels 18 and 19
  4. Feral ChargeFeral ChargeLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost5 RageRange25 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldown 1, level 20
  5. Savage FurySavage FuryTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by 10%. 2, levels 21 and 22
  6. Sharpened ClawsSharpened ClawsTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by 6%. 2, levels 23 and 24
  7. LacerateLacerateLevel 25 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost15 RageRangeMeleeDuration15 secLacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for 20 damage over 15 sec plus 10% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target. 1, level 25
  8. Blood FrenzyBlood FrenzyTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantGives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point. 2, levels 26 and 27
  9. Predatory DisciplinePredatory DisciplineTalentCastInstantYour Ferocious Bite ability no longer converts extra Energy into damage, but still deals extra damage based on your excess Energy. 1, level 28
  10. Predatory StrikesPredatory StrikesTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by 150% of your level. 1, level 29
  11. Leader of the PackLeader of the PackSpell · PhysicalCastInstantWhile in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the Critical Strike chance of all party or raid members within 45 yards by 3%. 1, level 30
  12. Natural InstinctNatural InstinctTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 20% and increases your spell healing by 25% of your Intellect. 2, levels 31 and 32
  13. Predatory StrikesPredatory StrikesTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by 150% of your level. to 3/3, levels 33 and 34
  14. Rend and TearRend and TearTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by 15%. 5, levels 35 to 39
  15. Primal BitePrimal BiteTalent · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost20 RageRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownBite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 42 and generating a high amount of threat. 1, level 40
  16. Shifting PowerShifting PowerTalentCastInstantCost55% of base ManaCooldown8 sec cooldown 1, level 41
  17. Heart of the WildHeart of the WildTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your Intellect by 10%. In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 20% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 10%. 5, levels 42 to 46
  18. NaturalistNaturalistTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantReduces the cast time of your Healing Touch and Wild Growth spells by 0.5 sec and increases all damage you deal by 10%. 5, levels 47 to 51
  19. GenesisGenesisTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases the periodic damage and healing done by your spells and abilities by 10%. 5, levels 52 to 56
  20. Nature's ReachNature's ReachTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%. 2, levels 57 and 58
  21. Nature's MajestyNature's MajestyTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by 4%. 2, levels 59 and 60

Why the points outside Feral. Heart of the WildHeart of the WildTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your Intellect by 10%. In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 20% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 10%. 5/5 is +10% Strength in Cat Form and +10% Intellect. NaturalistNaturalistTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantReduces the cast time of your Healing Touch and Wild Growth spells by 0.5 sec and increases all damage you deal by 10%. 5/5 is +10% to all damage. GenesisGenesisTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases the periodic damage and healing done by your spells and abilities by 10%. 5/5 is +10% periodic damage. Nature's ReachNature's ReachTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%. 2/2 is +4% hit; Icy Veins says to move those points once gear covers the 8% cap.

Dual Specialization is sold by your class trainer at 40 for 50 gold, per Wowhead, so a second build is a purchase, not a respec.

Stat priority

Weapon damage first, then hit and expertise to their caps at 60, then Agility and Strength.

  1. Weapon DPS. Icy Veins puts it first. WoWSims' weights rate 1 weapon DPS at about 2.0, against 0.52 for a point of Agility and 0.50 for Strength (WoWSims' model)
  2. Hit to 8% and expertise to 6.5% against raid bosses, per Icy Veins. Nature's ReachNature's ReachTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%. 2/2 supplies 4% of the hit. Both are rare on gear until the higher levels
  3. Agility: 1 attack power in Cat Form, and 1% crit and 1% dodge per 20
  4. Strength: 2 attack power, 10% more with Heart of the WildHeart of the WildTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your Intellect by 10%. In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 20% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 10%.
  5. Critical strike, then attack power

Wowhead's list differs and predates launch (October 29, labelled speculative): crit, hit, expertise, haste, then weapon DPS, with Agility equal to Strength. While levelling, both sites reduce it to the same thing: the highest-DPS weapon you can hold, then Agility and Strength.

Your weapon's damage counts in Cat Form, which reverses a Classic habit. Auto-attack DPS in form equals your weapon's DPS, at a fixed 1.0-second swing in Cat Form and 2.5 seconds in Bear Form, so weapon speed does not matter.
